props.gloss_en: the mishna: one who bathed in cave water or Tiberias water and dried himself, even with ten towels, may not bring them in his hand
the mishna teaches cave water alongside Tiberias water: as Tiberias water is hot, so the cave water is hot
'one who bathes': after the fact, yes; ab initio, no (the content names the bathing so restricted)
by implication: to rinse one's whole body is fine even ab initio
whose is [the mishna]? it is R' Shimon's
one may not rinse himself with hot water (R' Meir; R' Yehuda)
R' Meir: one may not rinse himself with cold water either
R' Shimon permits [rinsing, with hot water too]
rinsing with cold water is permitted (R' Shimon; R' Yehuda)
